businesses.what_they_do: Modern general, restorative and cosmetic dental practice in the Village Green center on Route 18, open six days a week with same-day emergency appointments. Services span preventive care (cleanings, fluoride, oral cancer screening), cosmetic work (veneers, whitening, Invisalign) and restorative treatment (crowns, fillings, implants, extractions), plus tooth-replacement options.
businesses.customers: East Brunswick families and the neighbouring towns of New Brunswick, North Brunswick Township, Milltown, Sayreville and Spotswood; insured patients (11+ named plans including NJ Family Care) plus uninsured patients drawn by the $165 new-patient special or CareCredit.

size_signals.signal: Site refers to 'our expert team of doctors' (plural) and offers same-day emergency availability, implying several providers
Open Monday-Saturday (Mon-Fri 10am-6pm, Sat 9am-2pm) - a six-day schedule
Site widget displays 4.5 with '300+ Google Reviews' - a high patient volume
Accepts 11+ named insurance plans plus CareCredit and has a dedicated financial-options page

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the limited Google Maps view I got; the practice's own site claims '300+ Google Reviews'

website_review.primary_cta: 'Book Appointment' buttons throughout, plus a top banner for the $165 new-patient special
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Advertised but MISSING. The site promises 'Online scheduling 24/7' and a 'Book Online, Anytime' page, but /contact contains no booking widget, no iframe and no form - the 'Book Online' button is only an anchor to #BookOnline, which is empty. The only working paths are the phone number and a Gmail address.
website_review.trust_signals: $165 new-patient special with itemised value, long accepted-insurance list, CareCredit, a patient-reviews section, 'Why patients choose us' block
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Website copy and the Google profile disagree on hours; the site still credits the build to 'Planet DDS'; the mobile hero image overflows the right edge of the viewport and is cut in half. The offer and copyright are current.
website_review.search_basics: Home page title and description name the practice and East Brunswick, and there is a proper Dentist JSON-LD block (address, geo, phone, email, hours) plus a WebSite block. But every service is a section on one long /services page with no individual service URLs, so nothing can rank for a specific procedure.
top_issues: The 'Book Online' promise is a dead end - there is no booking widget, form or iframe anywhere on /contact, so the headline claim 'Online scheduling 24/7' is false
Google shows 3.8 stars while the site displays '4.5 - 300+ Google Reviews', an inconsistency that invites distrust (inference: the widget may aggregate Yelp or be stale)
The Google Business Profile has no website link ('Add website' is prompted) and no photos
No click-to-call number in the mobile header - the phone appears only in body copy and the footer
Hours conflict inside the site: home page and JSON-LD say Mon-Fri 10-6, but the /contact call block says Mon-Thu 8-5
No intake form at all, so after-hours demand has nowhere to land

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: a Google place exists at the right address with a phone, but the rating is 3.8, there are no photos, and the profile has no website attached - all quickly fixable by the owner. robots.txt is fully open ('User-agent: *' with nothing disallowed) plus a sitemap. Answerable: hours, address, phone, email, insurance list, the $165 offer and detailed service descriptions are all readable text, and the home page carries a valid Dentist JSON-LD with geo coordinates and openingHoursSpecification (no priceRange). Bookable: zero - no form, no booking platform, no CAPTCHA wall because there is simply no path; the advertised online booking does not exist.

operations_signals.signal: Site advertises 'Online scheduling 24/7' and 'Book Online, Anytime' but no booking system is installed, so every after-hours booking intention becomes a phone call during office hours
Same-day emergency appointments are offered six days a week, a service line where an unanswered call is a lost patient
Inquiries route to a Gmail address (brunswickdentalgroup@gmail.com) rather than a practice-management inbox
300+ Google reviews at 3.8 stars means a steady stream of lower ratings with no visible response workflow on the site

top_opportunities.opportunity: Install real online scheduling connected to a working form, so the '24/7 online scheduling' promise is kept and after-hours demand converts
top_opportunities.evidence: /contact has no form, no iframe and no booking widget; 'Book Online' only jumps to an empty #BookOnline anchor while the site claims scheduling is available 24/7.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile (website link, photos, hours, services) and run a review-response workflow to lift the 3.8 rating
top_opportunities.evidence: The Google profile has no website attached (prompted to 'Add website'), no photos, and shows 3.8 against the site's claimed 4.5 / 300+ reviews.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Split the single long services page into individual treatment pages and fix the mobile header (click-to-call, hero image overflow)
top_opportunities.evidence: All services live on one /services page with no per-procedure URLs; the mobile hero image is cut off at the right edge and there is no tap-to-call in the header.

scores.reasons: Gap: a missing booking system behind a promise of 24/7 booking, an unmanaged 3.8 profile with no website link, no intake form and one flat services page. Ability to pay: a multi-doctor, six-day practice with 300+ reviews and a paid new-patient offer - solid mid-size revenue. Ease: modern Duda/Planet DDS site with clean pages; booking and profile fixes are quick. Evidence: read the homepage, contact, services and financial pages, the JSON-LD, robots.txt and the Google listing, and took a phone screenshot.

businesses.name: Dr. Gina Tanios-Rafla, DMD
businesses.status: operating (under new ownership): Google now lists the office as 'D&G Smile II, Laser Dentistry', and the website's opening paragraph names Dr. Ehab Aziz as the East Brunswick family dentist while the footer still credits Dr. Tanios-Rafla; a Healthgrades patient note says she retired and sold the practice in late 2024
businesses.what_they_do: Dental office at 646 State Route 18, Suite 114, trading as D&G Smile II / Laser Dentistry. Advertises a broad scope - cosmetic dentistry, laser dentistry, pediatric dentistry, oral and maxillofacial surgery, orthodontics, endodontics, tongue and lip tie treatment and emergency dentistry - for all ages, with a particular reputation for infant tongue/lip tie releases (the site's testimonials are almost entirely breastfeeding-tie stories).
businesses.customers: East Brunswick families and children, plus a strong niche of new parents seeking tongue and lip tie release for infants; adult cosmetic and general dentistry patients.

size_signals.signal: Business is now branded 'D&G Smile II' on Google and in its Zocdoc listing, with 'Dr. Ehab Aziz' named as the dentist on the website
Only three clinical days a week: Mon 9:30-6, Tue 8:30-4, Wed 8:30-5, closed Thursday, Friday and weekends
Single suite in a Route 18 office building; no associates or hygienists named
Google rating of 4.9 on the current practice listing

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the limited Google Maps view I got; listing name is 'D&G Smile II, Laser Dentistry'

website_review.phone_layout: unverified (automated browser was blocked with 403 Forbidden; reviewed via HTML fetch instead)
website_review.primary_cta: A Zocdoc 'Book Online' widget image linking to the D&G Smile II Zocdoc practice, plus the phone number (732) 238-1760
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Yes - a Zocdoc real-time booking widget for 'D&G Smile II' (Zocdoc practice 125996), a genuine booking platform rather than a request form
website_review.trust_signals: Extensive long-form patient testimonials about tongue/lip tie releases, a Google Maps badge, Facebook link; but no before/after photos of dentistry and no doctor bio for Dr. Aziz
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Confused identity on one page: the welcome text signs off as 'Dr. Ehab Aziz', the Zocdoc widget is branded 'D&G Smile II', and the footer still says 'Gina Tanios-Rafla, DMD'. The site is a ProSites template still carrying stock 'Family dentistry.jpg' imagery and a legacy Google+ badge image.
website_review.search_basics: Weak. The homepage title is generic ('Family Dentist East Brunswick NJ | 08816 Dentist') and there is no per-service page structure to speak of - the site leans on a single welcome page plus an appointment-request page. Nothing names D&G Smile II or Dr. Aziz in titles, so site and Google listing do not reinforce each other.
top_issues: Three different identities in one experience: 'Laser Dentistry' domain, 'D&G Smile II' on Google and Zocdoc, Dr. Ehab Aziz in the body, Dr. Gina Tanios-Rafla in the footer - nobody can tell who the dentist is

robots.txt blocks every crawler by default (User-agent: * Disallow: /); OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, Googlebot and Perplexity-User are allow-listed but PerplexityBot and GPTBot are not, and Disallow: /*?* blocks any URL with a query string
Automated browsers get '403 Forbidden' - an AI agent opening the site cold is turned away
No doctor bio, credentials or photo for the current dentist, and no before/after work on a site claiming cosmetic and surgical dentistry
Only three clinical days a week (closed Thursday, Friday and weekends), so the phone is unavailable most of the week

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: the Google place is live with a 4.9 rating, hours, phone and website, but it is branded 'D&G Smile II, Laser Dentistry' while the site's own titles say neither that name nor the current dentist, and the crawler policy is an allow-list that excludes PerplexityBot and GPTBot while blocking all unnamed agents. Answerable: hours, address, phone and a broad service list are text, but I found no schema.org markup in the fetched HTML, no prices, no service-area statement and no named doctor bio - an assistant quoting this practice will likely credit a retired dentist. Bookable: the strongest part - a real Zocdoc booking widget, which Google also reflects with a 'Book online' action.

operations_signals.signal: Phone is only answered three days a week (Mon-Wed), so any inquiry from Thursday to Sunday has no human path
The infant tongue/lip tie niche generates long, emotional inquiries that need careful pre-visit screening - the site's testimonials are all along these lines
Appointment requests land on a generic form page while actual booking runs through a separate Zocdoc account, splitting demand across two systems
Ownership changed hands recently (site copy and footer disagree), a period when listings, forms and phone routing typically break

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the identity mess: one practice name, one current dentist with a real bio and photo, consistent across the site, footer, Google profile, Zocdoc and page titles
top_opportunities.evidence: The homepage welcomes patients as Dr. Ehab Aziz, the footer signs off as Dr. Gina Tanios-Rafla, Google says D&G Smile II, and the Zocdoc widget says D&G Smile II - four identities for one office.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Open the crawler policy and stop 403-ing automated visitors so assistants can read and quote the practice
top_opportunities.evidence: robots.txt disallows all agents by default and does not allow PerplexityBot or GPTBot; an automated Chrome navigation returned '403 Forbidden'.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Consolidate booking into one path with proper intake for the tongue/lip tie niche, and add an after-hours auto-response covering Thursday-Sunday
top_opportunities.evidence: The office is closed Thursday, Friday and weekends while a Zocdoc widget and a separate request form run in parallel, and tie-release inquiries are detailed and time-sensitive.

scores.reasons: Gap: severe - three conflicting practice identities, no doctor bio, crawler-blocking robots.txt, 403 to agents, no schema, closed four days a week. Ability to pay: a single-suite practice open three days a week, though the tongue/lip tie niche is higher-ticket and the 4.9 rating is strong. Ease: the site is a small ProSites template, so identity and robots fixes are quick, but Zocdoc and ownership records are not ours to touch. Evidence: homepage and appointment pages fetched directly, robots.txt read, Google listing and browser 403 observed - the mobile layout could not be seen.

businesses.name: Kendall Road Family Dentistry
businesses.what_they_do: Family and cosmetic dental practice on Route 18 near the Brunswick Square Mall that says it has served East Brunswick for more than 50 years, continuing through the retirements of Dr. Wirtenberg (2004) and Dr. Matrone (2014). Uses digital x-rays, Tulsa endodontics and in-office root canals and extractions; offers cosmetic dentistry, crowns and bridges, dentures and partials, implant crowns, Invisalign and whitening.
businesses.customers: East Brunswick families and adults, including older patients inherited from two prior generations of the practice; general, prosthetic and implant-crown work.

size_signals.signal: Two named dentists: Dr. Brian Kwiatkowski and Dr. Susie Megalla (joined 2015)
Practice says it has provided cosmetic and family dentistry for more than 50 years
Open four weekdays 8-5 plus Saturday mornings 8:30-1, closed Wednesday
Legal entity in structured data is 'BRK Dental PC' at 704 State Route 18

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the limited Google Maps view I got

website_review.phone_layout: usable (not visually confirmed - the automated browser was blocked with 403; the HTML shows a header tel: link and a mobile hamburger menu)
website_review.primary_cta: 'Contact Us' buttons on the slider and a 'Contact Us' appointment button by the doctor bios; no 'book' language
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Lead-capture form injected by JavaScript from the vendor (smbleads.ibsmb.com), reCAPTCHA-protected; no online booking, no live availability
website_review.trust_signals: Detailed doctor bios with training and society memberships, 50+ years in practice, a Facebook page, a patient-education library and a blog
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Slider image alt text is keyboard garbage ('sdwwd', 'deeeg', 'qweqeqweqw', 'weqrqbb'); the home page still says 'Testimonial Coming Soon!'; a COVID-19 page sits in the main navigation; an IE9 warning is still in the source; the contact form is JavaScript-injected so no form exists in the raw HTML
website_review.search_basics: Title and description name the practice, East Brunswick and cosmetic dentistry, and real service pages exist (/cosmetic-dentistry, /crowns-and-bridges, /dentures, /implant-crowns, /partial-dentures) plus a sitemap.xml. However, several service links point into a generic article library rather than practice pages, and the structured data names the business 'BRK Dental PC' rather than 'Kendall Road Family Dentistry', so entity matching is split.
top_issues: Structured data uses the legal name 'BRK Dental PC' with an @me.com email, while the brand everywhere else is 'Kendall Road Family Dentistry' - assistants may treat them as two businesses
No online booking, and the only form is injected by vendor JavaScript and protected by reCAPTCHA, so an agent reading the page sees no way to contact the practice
Automated browsers receive '403 Unauthorized', which blocks agent visits even though robots.txt warmly allows every AI crawler
'Testimonial Coming Soon!' placeholder, keyboard-mash image alt text and a live COVID-19 nav item make the site look abandoned
JSON-LD hours are correct but nothing in the copy covers emergencies or new-patient pricing

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: complete Google profile with 4.5 rating, hours, phone and website, and robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot and Google-Extended. Answerable: hours, doctors, services and location are real text and MedicalBusiness JSON-LD is present with address, geo, telephone, priceRange ('Call for pricing options') and correct openingHoursSpecification - but the business name in schema does not match the brand. Bookable: no booking system; the contact form only exists after vendor JavaScript runs and is reCAPTCHA-gated, and a direct automated browser visit returned '403 Unauthorized'.

operations_signals.signal: Two dentists covering a four-day week plus Saturday mornings with Wednesday closed - front-desk coverage is thin on the busiest days
New-patient contact depends on a JavaScript lead form, so any enquiry where the script fails is lost silently
The practice inherited patients through two dentist retirements (2004, 2014), meaning a large dormant/recall list worth reactivating
The site still maintains a COVID-19 page, suggesting communications were last actively managed around 2020-21

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add real online booking and a static, server-rendered appointment form so requests survive script failures and can be completed by an agent
top_opportunities.evidence: There is no booking system; the only form is injected from smbleads.ibsmb.com and reCAPTCHA-gated, and the raw HTML contains no form at all.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Reconcile the business identity and clean the stale artifacts: use 'Kendall Road Family Dentistry' in schema, replace the 'Testimonial Coming Soon!' block with real reviews, fix the keyboard-mash alt text and retire the COVID-19 page
top_opportunities.evidence: Schema names 'BRK Dental PC' with an @me.com email; slider alt text reads 'sdwwd'/'qweqeqweqw'; the home page still shows 'Testimonial Coming Soon!' and the nav still lists COVID-19.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Run a recall and reactivation campaign for the inherited patient list with automated reminders, since the practice is built on 50 years of hand-me-down patients
top_opportunities.evidence: The practice explicitly continues after Dr. Wirtenberg's 2004 and Dr. Matrone's 2014 retirements, and is closed Wednesdays - a schedule that only works if recall is automated.

scores.reasons: Gap: no booking, identity mismatch in schema, 403 to agents, plus visible neglect (garbage alt text, 'Coming Soon' testimonial, COVID page). Ability to pay: two dentists, 50+ years, four-day week plus Saturdays - a stable established practice. Ease: the Officite/vendor platform limits direct edits and the site blocks automated browsers, so changes need vendor cooperation. Evidence: homepage HTML, schema, robots.txt and the Google listing read directly, but the visual/mobile review was blocked by 403.

caveats: Every browser tab title rendered through the automation harness is prefixed with a horse emoji; I confirmed this is a harness artifact (it also appears on google.com/maps) and not a site defect.

Three sites (foundationfamilydentistryllc.com, kendallroadfamilydentistry.com, laserdentistnj.com) returned '403 Unauthorized'/'403 Forbidden' to automated Chrome navigation while still serving content to ordinary fetches. I recorded that as an observed agent-readiness problem, but it also means I could not visually review their mobile layouts.
data_gaps: Google Maps served a 'limited view' for every place page, so review counts were not rendered - only star ratings are recorded here. Brunswick Dental Group's own site claims '300+ Google Reviews'.
NUVA Smile and Garden State Dental were triaged only lightly because they are multi-location chains, which the brief excludes.
Village Dental Associates could not be verified as operating; the named dentist's 2021 obituary and an unclaimed Google profile are the only evidence found.
Phone-width screenshots were captured for Dr. Bogomolny, TKI and Brunswick Dental Group only; the other sites either blocked automated browsing or were reviewed from HTML.
